home.title: AxionIA
home.subtitle: Operational AI consultancy
home.description: On-site AI sessions, audits and implementation for companies.
home.heroDescription: We come to your company to show you what AI can concretely do for you. Diagnostic, live demos, costed action plan. You leave with visible gains within the first weeks.
home.valueEyebrow: Three services to transform your company
home.valueDescription: Pick what fits your need. No commitment, no technical prerequisite. You test, you see, you decide.
home.value1Bullet1: Your teams see AI applied to their work — on your real cases, your real documents, your real tasks.
home.value1Bullet2: We demonstrate the AI tools that will save them 1 to 3 hours per day.
home.value1Bullet3: You leave with a costed 90-day action plan + 3 immediate actions.
home.value1Gain: You gain: time every day, teams onboarded, better work quality.
home.value2Bullet1: We map every process — where AI can lower your staff costs, grow your revenue, fatten your margins.
home.value2Bullet2: Each opportunity costed: what it costs to deploy vs what it brings back.
home.value2Bullet3: Full audit or focused on one department (sales, HR, support, operations…) — your choice.
home.value2Gain: You gain: a clear view of everything AI can bring you, and where to start.
home.value3Bullet1: Chatbot, AI customer support, automatic meeting minutes, presentation generation, sales enablement, business automations.
home.value3Bullet2: Built for your company, your business, your data — not an off-the-shelf generic tool.
home.value3Bullet3: Progressive go-live with your teams + 30-day support included to fine-tune.
home.value3Gain: You gain: time saved every day, lower costs, more revenue.
home.valueWhy1: Concrete, not POC: we work on your real data from day one.
home.valueWhy2: No commitment: no subscription, no 12-month contract — fixed quote, your call every time.
home.valueWhy3: Your data stays in Europe: Hetzner Frankfurt hosting, strict GDPR, never resold.
home.valueWhy4: End-to-end personalised service: you talk directly to the consultant, not a sales middleman.
home.modulesDescription: Three entry points to integrate AI in your company — no risk, no commitment, at your own pace.
home.module1Description: One day on site with your team: diagnostic, AI demos, 90-day plan. From €490.
home.module2Description: Complete mapping of your AI opportunities, per-use-case costing, prioritised action plan. €290 to €1,990.
home.module3Description: Production deployment: chatbot, agents, RAG, automations, custom AI. From €990.
home.metric1Label: To see your first measurable gains
home.metric2Label: Of your data stays in Europe
home.methodDescription: No engagement without a demo on your data. No costing without mapping. No deployment without support.
home.method1Description: Free discovery call to qualify your need and pick the right module.
home.method2Description: 1-day session, 5-day audit or 4-week prototype depending on the chosen module.
home.method3Description: Prioritised PDF deliverable: estimated ROI, complexity, deployment sequence.
home.method4Description: Implementation, user testing, go-live, 30-day support included.
home.casesDescription: Five real cases documented with context, problem, solution and post-delivery figures.
home.roiDescription: Four sliders, instant 12-month calculation. No personal data input required.
home.faqDescription: The five questions our consultants get during scoping calls.
home.ctaBlockDescription: One day on site, three quick-wins identified, costed 90-day plan. No AI prerequisite.
